admin.title: Cafeteria
admin.current-missing: The %1 menu hasn't been uploaded. The widget will be empty this month.
admin.upload-help: Pick the monthly menu JSON file. An existing month is replaced.
admin.overwrite: This month already exists. Saving replaces it.
admin.bad-json: Couldn't read the file. Pick a valid JSON file.
admin.no-month-field: The file has no "ay" field (for example "2026-09").
admin.confirm-delete: Delete the %1 menu? This can't be undone.
admin.how-1: Download the cafeteria's monthly menu PDF.
admin.how-2: Convert it to JSON with the plugin's tools/pdf2json.py script.
admin.how-3: Upload the JSON file on this page.
admin.how-4: Drag the "Cafeteria menu" widget into an area under Extend → Widgets.
error.not-object: The menu must be a JSON object.
error.month-mismatch: The file's month (%1) doesn't match the selected month (%2).
error.no-days: The menu has no days, or more than 31.
error.bad-meal: A meal must be a list of at most 40 dishes: %1
error.bad-source: The source link must start with http:// or https://.
admin.hours-help: The widget shows these hours next to each meal. It says "Now" while a meal is served and "Next" before it, and moves to tomorrow after the last meal.
error.bad-hours: Invalid hours (%1). Each meal must start before it ends, and meals must follow each other without overlapping.
